subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the sole protected-environment production deployment authority for openclaw/crawl-remote under this forward-only D1 recovery model?
rationale: The implementation mechanics are well-supported, but production credential ownership, cross-repository authority, and acceptance of non-reversible migrations are operational trust decisions that source review cannot make.

options.title: Approve staged cutover
options.body: Merge the companion retirement first, land this workflow with authority unset, provision unique protected credentials, and rehearse dormant rollout and rollback before activation.

options.title: Retain service-owned authority
options.body: Keep production deployment and credentials within crawl-remote and do not activate this centralized path.

options.title: Require stronger recovery
options.body: Pause the cutover until operators approve a different migration or database recovery strategy.

recommendation.title: Approve staged cutover
recommendation.body: Merge the companion retirement first, land this workflow with authority unset, provision unique protected credentials, and rehearse dormant rollout and rollback before activation.

likelyOwner.reason: His history across CI, publishing architecture, action pinning, and releases makes him the strongest available owner for the repository-level production trust decision.
